ground_truth.title: Smart Thermostats
ground_truth.main_content:
Enjoy “just-right” indoor temperatures all day long.

You know what a comfortable home feels like. A WiFi-enabled ENERGY STAR certified smart thermostat can learn your preferences, adjust itself automatically—and save you money year after year.

Plus, when you purchase an ENERGY STAR certified unit, you can receive a post-purchase rebate up to $100. PSE&G customers can also find deals on smart thermostats by shopping online at the PSE&G Marketplace.

Purchase a qualifying smart thermostat from any retailer and submit a rebate claim within 120 days of purchase. You should receive your rebate check approximately six weeks after PSE&G reviews your application and documentation.

Savings at a glance.

8%

cost reduction

The average ENERGY STAR certified smart thermostat saves a household approximately 8% on heating and cooling costs each year. *

$50

annual savings

Depending on the climate, households that utilize a smart thermostat can save approximately $50 on energy costs each year. *

See if you qualify for a PSE&G rebate.

Upon installation, the smart thermostat must control a system with electric or gas heating and/or central air conditioning.
The appliance must be ENERGY STAR certified. Visit the ENERGY STAR website to verify the certification of your smart thermostat.
Customers applying for a rebate must have an active PSE&G residential account. Commercial and multi-family properties are not eligible.
The model number must be listed on the application or invoice. If the model number is not listed on the invoice/receipt, a SKU or item number corresponding to the model number on the store’s website must be available.
Rebate claim must be submitted within 120 days of purchase. The receipt or invoice must contain the day, month, and year of purchase.
Refurbished appliances, open-box appliances, and leased appliances do not qualify. This applies to all rent-to-own appliances, lease-to-own appliances, and appliances in layaway at stores such as Rent-A-Center and Aaron’s. If the receipt shows the terms “lease to own” or “rent to own,” then a balance owed of $0 must also be shown, or the appliance must be paid for (upfront and in full) to qualify for a rebate.
The rebate amount cannot exceed the value of the purchase.
Equipment purchased from any utility’s online marketplace is not eligible for a rebate.
Limit of two smart thermostat rebates per account.

Browse frequently asked questions.

Here, you can find responses to the most commonly asked questions about our appliance rebates. Click the “plus” icon next to any question to read more.

Look for PSE&G signage in stores at participating retailers to save instantly on the appliances listed below. Your instant discount will automatically be reflected in the purchase price at checkout.
- Air Purifiers – $50 instant discount
- Dehumidifiers – $40 instant discount
- Air Conditioners (room or window unit) – $30 instant discount
- Ventilation Fans – $25 instant discount
- Electric Push Lawn Mowers – $50 instant discount
- Electric Ride-On Lawn Mowers – $75 instant discount
- Electric Snow Blowers – $25 instant discount
- Electric Leaf Blowers – $25 instant discount
- Electric Hedge Trimmers – $25 instant discount
- Electric Chainsaws – $25 instant discount

The appliances listed below qualify for post purchase rebates. Visit the product pages linked below to determine which models are eligible. Applications for post purchase rebates must be submitted online within 120 days of purchase. Contact PSE&G at 1‑855‑846‑2895 with questions or if you need help completing your online application.
- Dishwashers – $30 post-purchase rebate
- Washers – $100 post-purchase rebate
- Electric Dryers – post-purchase rebate up to $300
- Refrigerators – post-purchase rebate up to $100
- Freezers – $25 post-purchase rebate
- Smart Thermostats – post-purchase rebate up to $100
- Induction Cooktops – $250 post-purchase rebate
- Gas Storage Water Heaters – $400 post-purchase rebate
- Heat Pump Water Heaters – $750 post-purchase rebate
- Tankless Water Heaters – $500 post-purchase rebate

There are no limitations on the purchases of appliances that are eligible for instant discounts. However, you may only claim one post-purchase rebate (per appliance type) on your account each year. The exception is smart thermostats, for which you are eligible for two rebates during the lifetime of the account.

Instant discounts are available to all PSE&G customers who shop in-store at participating retailers.

Only current residential account holders are eligible to apply for post-purchase rebates from PSE&G.

Rebate eligibility varies by individual appliance types for customers who receive electric-only service or gas-only service through PSE&G. For example, if PSE&G only provides you with gas service and you’d like to claim a rebate on an electrical appliance (such as a refrigerator), you need to instead check with your electric utility provider to find out if they offer rebates. In this instance, you’d be ineligible to claim a rebate with PSE&G.

Butler Electric customers who receive PSE&G residential gas service are also eligible for post-purchase rebates on electric appliances.

No. Rent-to-own appliances, lease-to-own appliances, open-box appliances, and appliances in layaway at stores such as Rent-A-Center and Aaron’s don’t qualify.

If the receipt shows the terms “lease to own” or “rent to own,” then a balance owed of $0 also must be shown, or the appliance must be paid for upfront and in full, to qualify for a rebate.

No. Post-purchase rebates can only be issued in the form of a check.

Once we confirm that your rebate application is complete and that you meet all eligibility requirements, you can expect your rebate check to be delivered to your address within six weeks.

Room air conditioners, dehumidifiers, ventilation fans, air purifiers/cleaners, and electric outdoor equipment are only discounted through participating retailers.

However, post-purchase rebates are available for appliances purchased at any retailer as long as the paid receipt shows the retailer name, model number, and purchase price. The rebate amount can’t exceed the value of the purchase.

Equipment purchased from any utility company’s online marketplace isn’t eligible for a rebate.

Yes. If your property owner, management company, or association is a PSE&G residential account holder, you may be eligible for a rebate. Before PSE&G can process your rebate, you may need to provide documentation that your utility bill is included in your rent or association fees.

Please call 1-855-846-2895 for more information.

Did you know?

You can visit our All Appliances page to browse other rebates and discounts on energy-efficient products for your home—such as washers, dryers, refrigerators, dishwashers, and more.

This program is subject to change, including termination, without prior notice.

FlexPower Program: a simple way to get money back.

Have an ecobee, Google Nest, Honeywell, or Sensi smart thermostat? Earn money and manage your energy use with FlexPower.

PSE&G will automatically cool your home or small business before energy demand is highest, then return your settings to normal during off-peak hours. Better yet, you’ll receive $50 for enrolling, and additional rebates for each year you participate.

See if your smart thermostat is eligible for a rebate.

Confirm if your selected smart thermostat is ENERGY STAR certified.

Shop the PSE&G Marketplace and keep saving.

We offer smart thermostats and other energy-efficient products at discounted prices exclusively for customers like you.
